notes: Seasonal slot: travel 'we tested 5 shoes' ranking (Kyro 293: C$58k, 2.15 ROAS; Kyro 369: C$67k; Kyro 373: C$61k), which performed well late October to early November last year. Competitors named at the user's request; claims are taken from the winning scripts. The Friday 2026-10-23 run keeps these 7 and adds 33 more to fill the batch of 40 (mixed offer stack, foot-pain leads, cartoon/native formats, Spanish).

concepts.angle: Ranked test: 5 popular travel shoes on European cobblestones
concepts.based_on: Kyro 293 'We tested five of the most popular ones' (C$58k, 2.15 ROAS); Kyro 369 (C$67k)
concepts.headline: We tested 5 travel shoes on European cobblestones.
concepts.prompt: Ranking ad on a warm cream background with a faint cobblestone street photo at the top. Headline in bold black: "We tested 5 travel shoes" second line in purple: "on European cobblestones." Below, five ranked rows, each a white rounded card with a big rank number on the left and a short verdict: "5 Sandals: no protection on rough stone" with a red X, "4 Nike Air Max: narrow toe box" with a red X, "3 Hoka: unstable on uneven streets" with a red X, "2 Skechers Memory Foam: flat by afternoon" with a red X, and a highlighted purple-bordered card "1 Comfort Wear: firm on cobblestones, room to swell" with a green check and the shoe from the reference photo beside it. Text only names, no other brand logos.

A table with four columns: "Nike Air Max", "Hoka", "Skechers", "Comfort Wear" (column headers are text only, no shoe pictures; only the last column, highlighted in light lavender, shows the shoe from the reference photo above it). The Comfort Wear column has a green check in every row; the other columns have mostly red X marks (Nike: X, X, X, check; Hoka: X, check, X, X; Skechers: X, X, check, check). Large, legible cells.
